== Biography ==
{{African-American Sticker}}

Jacob was born in 1830. He is the son of [[Glasgow-3823|Samuel Glasgow]] and [[Glasgow-3824|Elizabeth Glasgow]].


== Research Notes ==
=== Father review, 12 November 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-3823|Samuel Glasgow]] is now assessed at 95% (strongly supported), previously 89% probable. The official Chester County school index names Samuel Glasco with Jacob aged six at East Marlborough in 1836, then Samuel with Jacob aged six and Zephenia aged five at New Garden in 1837. The matching names, ages and child group corroborate the held 1850 Samuel/Elizabeth household, where Jacob is aged twenty; Jacob's later household with Jesse supplies additional family continuity. The records describe a sustained parent-and-children household rather than one unexplained census association.

Confidence is a strongly supported family inference, not genetic proof or a literal birth-register parent clause. The county index pages 365–366 were inspected; the underlying school and tax manuscripts were not. School returns can list a guardian and can carry an age forward. The repeated surname, coherent child group and independent census context favour ordinary parentage over that unsupported alternative. Mother Elizabeth and Samuel’s own unknown father are not reassessed. The 1850 index is reused; no original census reading is claimed.

Source: [https://www.chesco.org/DocumentCenter/View/83915/Poor-School-Children-1810-1842 Chester County Archives, Poor School Children 1810–1842, PDFpp 365–366]. The older review below is retained as assessment history; this review supersedes its father percentage.

=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3823]] is assessed at 89% (probable). Jacob's 1830 birth and 1850 entry in the Samuel/Elizabeth household fit Samuel's 1804 generation. His 1860 household with Jesse supplies an additional sibling bridge, but no early census relationship column exists.

Selected Glasgow-3823 fatherhood of Glasgow-3825; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare original 1850 group with Jacob's death parents.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M4HM-J4K "United States, Census, 1850", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M4HM-J4K : Tue Jan 14 03:08:39 UTC 2025), Entry for Samuel Glasgo and Elizabeth Glasgo, 1850.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
